name: project_path_doctor
purpose: Windows PATH auditor that reports dead entries, duplicates and shadowed executables, resolving machine and user PATH in true composition order.
notes: First Rust project on this machine, chosen as a workflow shakedown. Read-only by design: it reports, it never writes PATH. Born from real PATH shadowing hit during machine provisioning on 2026-09-15. Slice 1 is complete - registry reading and composition (winreg, chosen over the windows crate so the unsafe stays in the dependency), per-entry findings, executable enumeration with PATHEXT read from the environment, shadow resolution, and the output layer with a versioned JSON contract in docs/SPEC.md. All six acceptance bullets in the spec are covered by tests. A GUI is a confirmed consumer, so the serialisation shape is defined once in pathdoc-core behind a serde feature rather than mirrored in the front end; it is at schemaVersion 2, which replaced a conflicts-only shadows array with a full executables array after three of the four names worth reporting turned out to appear exactly once. Next is the roadmap: shell alias masking, decoding WindowsApps stubs, and an env-var backup/diff tool sharing the registry layer.
